name: Ropewalker's Palm Wraps
description: Strips of tarred linen wound over the heel of the hand.
benefit: Grip holds on wet rope and rock without slipping.
cost: The tar stains everything touched, and clean work is remembered.

name: Hegemon Tally Gauntlets
description: Studded with one bronze rivet for every town counted and taxed.
benefit: Blows with the fist land harder and shrug off a parry.
cost: Wearing the rivets announces whose man you are in every free town.

name: Temenos Warden's Gloves
description: Kid gloves kept clean to handle the boundary stones of a sanctuary.
benefit: Opens sanctuary gates and lifts holy objects without offence.
cost: Cannot be worn to strike, or the sanctuary's protection is forfeit.

name: Lampblack Thief's Mitts
description: Soot-rubbed leather, soft as a cat's foot.
benefit: Locks and latches give up their secrets in near silence.
cost: Soot leaves prints on every surface, and the trail leads back.

name: Shearer's Leather Cuffs
description: Thick cuffs cut for the long wool-shearing season.
benefit: Reduces the strain of heavy repeated work with blades and tools.
cost: The stiff leather dulls fine touch, so delicate tasks go slowly.

name: Bound Wristlets of the Silent Priestess
description: Linen bands knotted with a prayer no one now remembers.
benefit: Steadies the hands against fear and the shakes.
cost: The knots tighten when the wearer lies, and the bearer feels every one.

name: Kiln-Tong Gauntlets
description: Clay-caked mitts built to pull pots from the firing pit.
benefit: Handles hot metal and embers with no burn.
cost: So bulky that nothing small can be picked up while wearing them.

name: Salt-Flat Sandals
description: Cork soles lashed with sea-grass, white with dried brine.
benefit: Crosses mud, shallows and salt pans without sinking.
cost: The soles wear through fast and need regular replacement.

name: Courier's Hobnail Boots
description: Studded for the long road between garrison towns.
benefit: Covers long distances on roads with less fatigue.
cost: The nails ring on stone, and no one sneaks in them.

name: Thread-Soled Slippers
description: Wound with a red thread that unspools as the wearer walks.
benefit: Never lose the way back from a maze or tangle of corridors.
cost: The thread must be reeled in afterward, and anything can follow it.

name: Stopped-Hour Sandals
description: Sandals sold to those who wished to arrive before they left.
benefit: The first step of every dash is strangely swift.
cost: A heartbeat of weakness follows each burst, when time catches up.

name: Furrow-Walker's Boots
description: Mud-caked boots from fields that would not sprout again.
benefit: Walks over ploughed and blighted ground without slowing.
cost: Bears a faint curse of hunger that dulls the appetite for rest.

name: Ash-Walker's Foot Wraps
description: Rags soaked in lye and wound over bare soles.
benefit: Crosses embers, ash and hot ground unhurt.
cost: The lye stings, and a long walk leaves the feet raw.

name: Pilgrim's Vowed Soles
description: A pair of thin soles tied on with the vow of a barefoot road.
benefit: Footfalls are silent and sure on temple ground.
cost: Breaking the vow by wearing other shoes brings ill luck on the road.

name: Garrison Tower Shield
description: A door-sized slab carried on the wall of a hegemon's keep.
benefit: Blocks nearly every blow from the front and holds a line.
cost: Impossible to run in, and slow to bring about.

name: Amphictyony Voting Tablet
description: A bronze tablet bearing the mark of an allied city.
benefit: Carries the weight of a league vote into any parley.
cost: Every use is recorded, and the cities can call the bearer to account.

name: Case of the Foretold Scroll
description: A scroll case whose seal will break only at the written hour.
benefit: Reveals one warning of coming danger, though not its shape.
cost: The scroll fixes the bearer's attention, and surprises are more dangerous.

name: Hecatomb Butcher's Cleaver
description: A broad cleaver kept for the hundredfold sacrifice.
benefit: Rips through sacrificial offerings and heavy hides in one pass.
cost: Blood-reek follows the bearer and draws every predator within a mile.

name: Lantern Shield of the Descent
description: A small round shield with a shuttered flame at its heart.
benefit: Lights the dark and wards off the shades.
cost: The flame burns oil quickly and gutters in the wind.

name: Blind Seer's Walking Staff
description: A smooth staff of olive wood, tapped three times at each step.
benefit: Taps out hidden steps, traps and drops before they are reached.
cost: The tapping carries, and everything nearby knows exactly where you are.

name: League Pilot's Wide Hat
description: A wide-brimmed felt hat dyed with the League's blue.
benefit: Shields the eyes from glare and spray on open water.
cost: Reads as league property, and rival ports watch the wearer.

name: Oath-Binding Circlet
description: A thin ring of bronze struck at the swearing stone.
benefit: Oaths the bearer swears are harder for others to talk them out of.
cost: A broken oath costs the bearer far more than usual.

name: Mask of the Last Favour
description: A funeral mask carved for a debt that was never called.
benefit: Strangers owe the bearer small kindnesses without knowing why.
cost: The debt is always collected, usually at the worst moment.

name: Reed Filter Hood
description: A hood stuffed with dried herbs and woven reed.
benefit: Keeps the lungs clear in foul air and marsh fog.
cost: Muffles hearing and narrows the field of view.

name: Orichalcum Smith's Visor
description: A cap with a dark-glass slit, for staring into the furnace.
benefit: Looks at bright forges and flares without being blinded.
cost: The dark glass leaves everything else in gloom.

name: Hourless Diadem
description: A silver ring set with a glass that holds no sand.
benefit: Slows the passage of fear and weariness for a time.
cost: Afterward the delayed weariness lands all at once.

name: Gale Cloak of the Straits
description: Waxed wool that has weathered a hundred storms.
benefit: Turns aside rain, spray and cold winds.
cost: Stiff with wax, it creaks and stinks of fish.

name: Satrap's Brocade Robe
description: A heavy robe stitched in gold thread, all show and no weave.
benefit: Doors open and guards stand aside for anyone who wears it.
cost: Marks the bearer as a target for every thief and rebel.

name: Hegemon's Lamellar Cuirass
description: Bronze plates laced in rows, the pride of the standing army.
benefit: Strong protection against blade and arrow.
cost: Heavy and hot, and it slows the wearer on long marches.

name: Initiate's Veiling Shroud
description: A plain dark shroud worn into the rites below the temple.
benefit: Passes through mystery cults unchallenged as a member.
cost: Outsiders who see the shroud will not speak freely to the bearer.

name: Harvest-Mother's Apron
description: A deep apron sewn with pockets for gleaned seed.
benefit: Carries extra seed and grain without added weight.
cost: Heavy with the memory of loss, it shows the bearer's grief.

name: Temenos Peace-Knife
description: A ritual blade tied with a white cord and never drawn in anger.
benefit: Cuts offerings, cords and veils cleanly, and carries a sacred authority.
cost: Drawing it in a fight breaks the sanctuary's peace and brings pursuit.

name: Unbinding Chain-Flail
description: A length of broken shackle on a hardwood haft.
benefit: Swings wide and cuts through bindings, locks and ropes.
cost: Hard to control in tight quarters, and it strikes friends too.

name: Bow of the Absent Huntress
description: A short bow strung with a gut that never quite goes slack.
benefit: Shots at unaware foes fly farther and truer.
cost: The huntress is gone, and the beasts of the wild are not kind to the bearer.

name: Cracked Hourglass
description: A glass whose sand falls up, then stops, then falls.
benefit: Stretches one moment, once in a while, to let the bearer act.
cost: Sometimes the sand runs out early, and the moment is lost.

name: Bull-Horn Charm
description: A tip of horn bound in bronze wire, warm to the touch.
benefit: Hunters of the maze take the bearer for one of their own.
cost: The scent draws the thing that waits at the maze's heart.

name: Amphictyon Oath Seal
description: A thumb seal pressed on every treaty of the league.
benefit: Treaties sealed by it bind the other side as firmly as the bearer.
cost: Breaking the seal's word marks the bearer in every allied city.

name: Foretold Surveyor's Stakes
description: Pegs carved with the place and hour of a disaster.
benefit: Marks a site that will be safe from the next event to strike.
cost: Each stake used cannot be recovered, and the omen is visible to all.

name: Charon's Spare Lamp
description: A lamp lit from the ferryman's own brazier.
benefit: Lights the way across black water and reveals the dead.
cost: Burns only while the bearer owes the ferryman something.

name: Hecatomb Tally Rod
description: A notched rod counting a hundred offered beasts.
benefit: Counts herds and offerings and marks each for the gods.
cost: Notched with every kill, and the gods remember the total.
